svg.title: Public, owner, and producer authority lanes
svg.desc: Canonical projections can serve all three audience lanes. Transcript reads are filtered for each audience. Selected thinking and strategy can enter a viewer-safe public projection, while underlying cognitive artifacts require subject, participant, or producer policy. Private traces reach producer diagnostics only.
